title: Todd Monken says starting QB will play first half vs. Bears, but doesn't announce who it is

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken says starting QB will play first half vs. Bears, but doesn't announce who it is
sources.description: While Browns head coach Todd Monken again declined to announce who will start at quarterback in the club's first preseason game, he did give reporters an idea of planned playing time during his Wednesday press conference.
